cards.target: Ela costura as próprias roupas.
cards.english: She sews her own clothes.

cards.target: O jornal de hoje traz boas notícias.
cards.english: Today's newspaper has good news.

cards.target: Ele estuda engenharia na universidade.
cards.english: He studies engineering at the university.

cards.target: Eles jogam vôlei na praia.
cards.english: They play volleyball at the beach.

cards.target: Eles trabalham numa empresa de tecnologia.
cards.english: They work at a tech company.

cards.target: Ele termina o turno à meia-noite.
cards.english: He finishes his shift at midnight.

cards.target: Nós marcamos a viagem com antecedência.
cards.english: We book the trip in advance.

cards.target: Eu troco ideias com os colegas.
cards.english: I exchange ideas with my colleagues.

cards.target: Ela explica a matéria com muita paciência.
cards.english: She explains the material very patiently.

cards.target: Nós bebemos água de coco na praia.
cards.english: We drink coconut water at the beach.

cards.target: Nós caminhamos na praia de tarde.
cards.english: We walk on the beach in the afternoon.

cards.target: Ela caminha meia hora todo dia.
cards.english: She walks for half an hour every day.

cards.target: Nós compramos pão na padaria da esquina.
cards.english: We buy bread at the bakery on the corner.

cards.target: A gente aluga uma casa na praia no verão.
cards.english: We rent a house at the beach in the summer.

cards.target: Nós estamos de férias.
cards.english: We're on vacation.

cards.target: Eu tenho alergia a camarão.
cards.english: I'm allergic to shrimp.

cards.target: A rua está vazia a essa hora.
cards.english: The street is empty at this hour.

cards.target: Como eu chego na rodoviária?
cards.english: How do I get to the bus station?

cards.target: Vocês vão à praia neste fim de semana?
cards.english: Are you going to the beach this weekend?

cards.target: As notícias do dia são preocupantes.
cards.english: Today's news is worrying.

cards.target: Quando abre a padaria?
cards.english: When does the bakery open?

cards.target: A praia de Copacabana é famosa no mundo inteiro.
cards.english: Copacabana Beach is famous worldwide.

cards.target: Por que ela mudou de ideia?
cards.english: Why did she change her mind?

cards.target: A água do rio é clara e fria.
cards.english: The river water is clear and cold.

cards.target: Vou à padaria comprar pão.
cards.english: I'm going to the bakery to buy bread.

cards.target: Estou com preguiça de ir à academia.
cards.english: I'm feeling lazy about going to the gym.

cards.target: Uma fatia de pizza, por favor.
cards.english: A slice of pizza, please.

cards.target: Onde vocês vão passar as férias?
cards.english: Where are you spending your vacation?

cards.target: Qual é a melhor praia por aqui?
cards.english: What's the best beach around here?

cards.target: Por que não vamos à praia?
cards.english: Why don't we go to the beach?

cards.target: As praias do Nordeste são maravilhosas.
cards.english: The beaches of the Northeast are wonderful.

cards.target: Eu fui à praia com os amigos.
cards.english: I went to the beach with friends.

cards.target: A padaria da esquina tem o melhor pão.
cards.english: The bakery on the corner has the best bread.

cards.target: Ela precisa de férias urgente.
cards.english: She urgently needs a vacation.

cards.target: O caminho até a praia é bonito.
cards.english: The way to the beach is pretty.

cards.target: Ele consertou o celular em meia hora.
cards.english: He fixed the phone in half an hour.

cards.target: O jantar estava maravilhoso.
cards.english: The dinner was wonderful.

cards.target: Boa viagem! Manda notícias.
cards.english: Have a good trip! Send news.

cards.target: Eu quis comprar, mas era caro demais.
cards.english: I wanted to buy it, but it was too expensive.

cards.target: Eu quis te ligar, mas era muito tarde.
cards.english: I wanted to call you, but it was too late.

cards.target: As praias brasileiras são maravilhosas.
cards.english: Brazilian beaches are wonderful.

cards.target: Eu tô na correria hoje.
cards.english: I'm swamped today.

cards.target: Sei lá, não faço ideia.
cards.english: I dunno, I have no idea.

cards.target: Capaz! Eu nunca faria isso.
cards.english: No way! I would never do that.

cards.target: A gente almoçou numa churrascaria famosa.
cards.english: We had lunch at a famous steakhouse.

cards.target: A comida da cantina era boa e barata.
cards.english: The cafeteria food was good and cheap.

cards.target: Eu mereço férias!
cards.english: I deserve a vacation!

cards.target: Eu notei que ele estava nervoso.
cards.english: I noticed he was nervous.

cards.target: Que alívio, achei que tinha perdido.
cards.english: What a relief, I thought I'd lost it.

cards.target: Eu abri a janela porque estava abafado.
cards.english: I opened the window because it was stuffy.

cards.target: Nós estávamos com fome quando encontramos o restaurante.
cards.english: We were hungry when we found the restaurant.

cards.target: A gente soube na hora que era mentira.
cards.english: We knew right away that it was a lie.

cards.target: Enquanto eu tomava banho, o telefone tocou três vezes.
cards.english: While I was showering, the phone rang three times.

cards.target: Eu quis experimentar, mas já tinha acabado.
cards.english: I wanted to try it, but it was already gone.

cards.target: Eu bebi muita água de coco na praia.
cards.english: I drank a lot of coconut water at the beach.

cards.target: Eu sempre tomava café às sete, mas ontem tomei às oito.
cards.english: I always used to have coffee at seven, but yesterday I had it at eight.

cards.target: Ele tinha uma bicicleta vermelha.
cards.english: He had a red bicycle.

cards.target: A vida era mais simples naquela época.
cards.english: Life was simpler back then.

cards.target: A gente colecionava figurinhas.
cards.english: We used to collect sticker cards.

cards.target: Vocês gostavam de estudar?
cards.english: Did you use to like studying?
